en: Read Pico 0.8.0 changes the PDF partition: full reinstall required
Do not use OTA from 0.7.0 or older; use the full installer
Adds PDF reading with reflow, bookmarks and annotations
New plugin games and shutdown confirmation
Back up the SD card and a full flash image before installing
zh: Read Pico 0.8.0 更换 PDF 分区，必须完整重新安装
0.7.0 及更早版本请勿使用 OTA，请用完整安装包
新增 PDF 阅读：重排、书签与批注
EPUB 排版与词典能力改进
新增插件游戏与关机确认
安装前请备份 SD 卡和整片镜像
